client_question: Should our trampoline parks open on weekday mornings for school field trips?
acceptable_recommendations: Open weekday mornings for school groups, starting with a pilot
key_risks: Schools may not pay $600 when science museums charge $450, so bookings fall short of 120 groups a year; staffing early shifts
next_steps: Pilot school mornings in 5 parks and track group bookings against the roughly 70 a year needed to break even
model_answer: Open weekday mornings for school groups, starting with a pilot. Each park would host about 120 groups a year at $600, $72k of revenue against $40k of extra staff and utility costs, a $32k gain, and the parks are closed on weekday mornings now, so nothing is cannibalized. The main risk is that schools won't pay $600 when local science museums charge $450, so the next step is a 5-park pilot that tracks bookings against the roughly 70 groups a year each park needs to break even.
key_figures: Revenue per park = $72,000 a year (120 × $600); Gain per park = $32,000 a year ($72,000 − $40,000); Break-even = 66.7 groups a year per park ($40,000 ÷ $600)
